label: First touch
level_1: Ball often escapes control on receiving
level_3: Controls most passes cleanly at normal pace
level_5: Controls instantly into space, even under pressure

label: Short passing
level_1: Short passes often mis-weighted or misdirected
level_3: Reliable short passes to a free teammate
level_5: Accurate, well-weighted passes at speed with either foot

label: Long passing and switching
level_1: Rarely reaches a target over distance
level_3: Can find a teammate over distance when given time
level_5: Switches and long passes accurately, including first time

label: Dribbling and carrying
level_1: Loses the ball when moving with it
level_3: Carries the ball forward with control in open space
level_5: Carries at speed through tight areas with close control

label: 1v1 attacking
level_1: Avoids or loses most 1v1 duels
level_3: Beats a defender with a prepared move at times
level_5: Regularly beats defenders with changes of pace and direction

label: Shooting and finishing
level_1: Shots rarely hit the target
level_3: Hits the target from good positions
level_5: Finishes with power and placement from varied situations

label: Crossing
level_1: Crosses rarely reach the box
level_3: Delivers into the box from wide areas when unopposed
level_5: Picks out targets with varied deliveries under pressure

label: Heading
level_1: Avoids or mistimes headers
level_3: Heads clearances and passes with reasonable control
level_5: Attacks the ball and directs headers with purpose

label: Set pieces and restarts
level_1: Restarts are slow or often lose possession
level_3: Takes restarts correctly and keeps possession
level_5: Uses restarts quickly and creatively to gain an advantage

label: 1v1 defending
level_1: Dives in or is easily beaten
level_3: Stays on feet, delays and shows the attacker one way
level_5: Wins the ball cleanly with good timing and body position

label: Scanning and awareness
level_1: Rarely looks around before receiving
level_3: Checks surroundings before most receptions
level_5: Scans constantly and knows options before the ball arrives

label: Movement to receive
level_1: Stays still or hidden behind opponents
level_3: Moves into space to offer a passing option
level_5: Times movement to create and exploit space for the team

label: Supporting the ball carrier
level_1: Too far away or in line with the ball carrier
level_3: Offers angles and distances that help the ball carrier
level_5: Anticipates the next pass and supports at the right moment

label: Team shape and positioning
level_1: Often out of position for the team shape
level_3: Holds position in the shape most of the time
level_5: Adjusts position intelligently as the ball and play move

label: Decision-making
level_1: Often chooses the wrong option or hesitates
level_3: Makes sensible choices when given time
level_5: Picks the best option quickly in fast play

label: Pressing and defending as a unit
level_1: Presses alone or not at all
level_3: Presses when the team presses and covers teammates
level_5: Triggers and leads the team press with good angles

label: Transition after winning the ball
level_1: Slow to react when the team wins the ball
level_3: Looks to move the ball forward after winning it
level_5: Exploits the moment immediately with quick forward play

label: Transition after losing the ball
level_1: Switches off when the ball is lost
level_3: Recovers position after losing the ball
level_5: Reacts instantly to press or recover and prevent counters

label: Communication
level_1: Rarely talks to teammates
level_3: Gives simple, helpful information to teammates
level_5: Organises others with clear, timely communication

label: Composure under pressure
level_1: Rushes or panics when pressed
level_3: Stays calm in most pressured situations
level_5: Plays calmly and confidently under heavy pressure

label: Concentration
level_1: Attention drifts during play
level_3: Stays focused for most of a session or match
level_5: Maintains focus throughout and refocuses quickly after mistakes

label: Goalkeeper handling and shot-stopping
level_1: Struggles to hold or stop routine shots
level_3: Saves and holds most shots within reach
level_5: Makes difficult saves and holds or parries safely

label: Goalkeeper positioning and angles
level_1: Often out of position relative to the ball
level_3: Takes up sensible positions for most shots
level_5: Narrows angles and adjusts position constantly

label: Goalkeeper commanding the area
level_1: Stays on the line and rarely comes for the ball
level_3: Comes for balls into the area when clearly theirs
level_5: Dominates the area, claims and sweeps with confidence

label: Goalkeeper short distribution
level_1: Short throws and passes often go astray
level_3: Finds a nearby teammate reliably
level_5: Starts attacks quickly with accurate throws and passes

label: Goalkeeper long distribution
level_1: Kicks lack distance or direction
level_3: Kicks reach the intended area most of the time
level_5: Kicks accurately to targets to set up attacks

label: Goalkeeper 1v1 situations
level_1: Commits too early or stays rooted
level_3: Closes down and stays big in most 1v1s
level_5: Reads 1v1s well and times blocks or smothers

label: Speed and agility
level_1: Slow to accelerate or change direction
level_3: Moves and changes direction well for the age group
level_5: Explosive acceleration and sharp changes of direction

label: Coordination and balance
level_1: Often off balance when moving with or without the ball
level_3: Stays balanced in most movements
level_5: Balanced and coordinated in complex, fast movements

label: Endurance
level_1: Tires early in sessions and matches
level_3: Keeps working for most of a match
level_5: Maintains high intensity throughout
